notes.title: Big Bouncy Update
notes.content:
It is finally time. The update we have been talking about for the past few days is here.

[h2]But what is new ?[/h2]

We announced each new feature in a separate post, but here is a quick summary:
[list]
[*] 6 new Items (4 effect and 2 controllabale Items) 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1822300/view/3368146591332322817 style=button]Details[/url] 
[*] Create your custom presets
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1822300/view/3345628134328668155 style=button]Details[/url] 
[*] Improved graphics and lightning/glow
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1822300/view/3345628134317166906 style=button]Details[/url] 
[*] Complete new lobby to start your game
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1822300/view/3345628134325129479 style=button]Details[/url] 
[*] A big pile of achievements
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1822300/view/3368146591332365121 style=button]Details[/url] 
[/list] 

In addition to these big features, we also improved some things, like gameplay or new UI animations.

[h3]So what are you waiting for ? Download the update and see for yourself.[/h3]

notes.title: Coming soon - Achievements
notes.content:
Do you ever think about how we want you to keep playing our game ? 

Well, we can introduce lootboxes with skins for your paddle or the arcade automat.
We could even build a shop where you can buy coins for the skins. You get the idea. But these things are not our goal. So we take a step back and begin with the basics.

We will introduce many different achievements, you can try to achieve. Some are easy, some are difficult....

But we will not spoil it for you. So wait for the update and check out the achievements by yourself.

notes.title: Coming soon - New items
notes.content:
With the next update, we will add a total of six new items to increase the variety of items while you are playing.
For the controllable items, there are 2 new items, and for the effect items, there are 4 new ones.

But what are the new items exactly? Let us briefly explain each one.

[hr][/hr] 
[h1]Effect items[/h1]

[h3]Shrink Ball[/h3]
When the ball collects this item, it will shrink the ball temporarily. When the effect ends, the ball will return to its previous size. Also, the effect is stackable, so it is possible to shrink the ball 2 times, 3 times, or even more times.
[previewyoutube=kVMezRdoHjQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Enlarge Ball[/h3]
This item is the opposite of the "shrink ball." So when the ball collects it, the ball will be enlarged temporarily.
[previewyoutube=YvP4I_WnBis;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Arena Glitch[/h3]
When the ball collects this item, a glitchy distortion filter will be applied to the arena. This will temporarily decrease the visibility of the arena and makes hitting the ball(s) correctly more difficult for the player.
[previewyoutube=3J6YfF8EaeQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Double ball[/h3]
When the ball collects this item, the ball will be split into 2 balls. If the cloned ball leaves the arena, e.g., a goal is scored, the ball will disappear for ever and will not be spawned again.
[previewyoutube=iQzkma5sqzI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Controllable items[/h1]

[h3]Item Lock[/h3]
When the player activates this item, all other item slots of the opponents will be locked temporarily, and the opponents can no longer use their items. After the effect ends, the item slots of the opponents are unlocked, and all players can use their items again.
[previewyoutube=8f4tqPB9ifE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Goal Shield[/h3]
When the player activates this item, a barricade will be temporarily placed in front of the goal of the player who activated it. The barricade deflects all balls and therefore protects the player from losing life or preventing other players from scoring.
[previewyoutube=hD-_Q8flKQ0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Coming soon - Custom Preset
notes.content:
Image You just played a round of Bounce Ball-Neon Party Arcade and you had unending fun. You found the perfect gameplay settings but you are unable to save them for later, so you have to take a screenshot of the settings. 
And every time you want to play these settings, you have to spend a lot of time setting them up. 

[h3]Is there no other way?[/h3]

In this case, we have wonderful news for you. With the next update, you will be able to save your favorite gameplay settings in custom presets. We also implemented the option to rename, delete, or override your custom preset.

We are curious about what crazy presets you will be creating. You are welcome to post your favorite preset :csd2smile:

[hr][/hr] 
[previewyoutube=OLlwHVfbggY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Coming soon - New Lobby Menu
notes.content:
While developing the game and conducting playtesting, we noticed that the workflow for starting a new game can be a bit tedious and sometimes the players didn't know what to do. 

With this feedback in mind, we developed and designed a new menu. In the new menu, all the relevant actions to start a game are on one screen. We also added little visual effects to breathe life into the new menu.

So in the future, you can spend the time you used to spend in the menus on actual gameplay.

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Coming soon - Improved graphics and glow
notes.content:
Do you ever feel that our game lacks vibrancy? 

This is now a part of the past. In the next update, we reworked many graphics in the arena and also added a ton of glow and lightning. We also added a new particle effect. 

With this much lightning and glow, we truly have a "neon party". Let the neon glow consume you.
